macros.name: rcs
macros.doc: This macro let you typeset rcs keywords directly. The dollars will be stripped and the rest is typeset as normal text.

macros.name: rcsfilerev
macros.doc: There are also file-local macros, e.g. \rcsfilerev , which return the version control information of the current file, i.e. the file they are used in.

macros.name: rcsFullAuthor
macros.doc: Takes the username as argument and returns the full name if it was registered first with \rcsRegisterAuthor, otherwise it returns the given username. The star version returns the username in parentheses after the full name.

macros.name: rcsFullAuthor*
macros.doc: Takes the username as argument and returns the full name if it was registered first with \rcsRegisterAuthor, otherwise it returns the given username. The star version returns the username in parentheses after the full name.

macros.name: rcsFullRevision
macros.doc: Takes a revision number coming from a macro like \rcsrev , \rcsfilerev or a number as argument and returns the full name if it was registered first with \rcsRegisterRevision , otherwise it returns “Revision hrevision numberi”. The star version returns also the revision number leaded by ‘r’ in parentheses after the tag name, e.g. Name (1.2).

macros.name: rcsFullRevision*
macros.doc: Takes a revision number coming from a macro like \rcsrev , \rcsfilerev or a number as argument and returns the full name if it was registered first with \rcsRegisterRevision , otherwise it returns “Revision hrevision numberi”. The star version returns also the revision number leaded by ‘r’ in parentheses after the tag name, e.g. Name (1.2).

macros.name: rcskwdef
macros.doc: This macro is used to define the keyword values.

macros.name: rcskwsave
macros.doc: This macro lets you include and save any keyword you like.

macros.name: rcsmainfilename
macros.doc: The macro \rcsmainfilename hold the filename of the main LATEXfile.

macros.name: rcsnolinkurl
macros.doc: This macro allows you to write \rcsnolinkurl{\rcskw{HeadURL}} and get the Head URL typeset verbatim.

macros.name: rcspdfdate
macros.doc: Returns the last changed date of the whole document in a format needed for \pdfinfo.

macros.name: rcsRegisterRevision
macros.doc: Saves the revision’s name or tag by defining rcs@revision@⟨revisionnumber⟩ to it.

macros.name: rcsrev
macros.doc: The document global macros, like \rcsrev , return the latest version control information (keyword data) for the whole multi-file document, i.e. the information of the latest changed file of the document.

macros.name: rcssetmainfile
macros.doc: Saves the current filename and URL to macros.
